📌 Key points要点

⭐ Must know必须记住
  • Multiply: factor everything, cancel any top with any bottom, then multiply what is left.乘法：全部分解，任一分子可与任一分母约分，再把剩下的相乘。
  • Divide: multiply by the reciprocal of the SECOND fraction.除法：乘以第二个分式的倒数。
  • Division NPVs: both denominators AND the numerator of the divisor.除法的不允许值：两个分母，再加上除式的分子。

💡 Multiplying x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ the long way gives a degree-3 mess. Factor first and almost everything cancels before you multiply.硬乘 x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ 会得到一堆三次式。先分解，乘之前几乎全都约掉了。

  1. Multiply: factor every numerator and denominator, cancel common factors (top of one with bottom of any), then multiply what is left.乘法：把每个分子分母都分解，约去公因式（任一分子与任一分母之间都可以约），再把剩下的相乘。
  2. Divide: multiply by the reciprocal of the second fraction ("keep, change, flip"), then proceed as multiplication.除法：乘以第二个分式的倒数（「前不变、除变乘、后颠倒」），再按乘法做。
  3. NPVs for division come from THREE places: both original denominators AND the numerator of the divisor (it ends up on the bottom after flipping).除法的不允许值来自三处：两个原分母，以及除式的分子（颠倒后它跑到了分母）。

🧮 Key formulas关键公式

BA​⋅DC​=BDAC​
Multiplying (B,D=0)分式相乘（B,D=0）
BA​÷DC​=BA​⋅CD​
Dividing (B,C,D=0)分式相除（B,C,D=0）
🎯 Test tip考试提示
Division questions are where NPV marks are lost: list the restrictions BEFORE you flip, from all three denominators-to-be.除法题最容易丢不允许值的分：在颠倒之前，从三个（将要成为的）分母中写全限制条件。

🧭 How to get started怎么入手

Ask yourself these five, in order, before writing anything. Every worked example on this page is labelled with them.动笔之前，按顺序问自己这五个问题。本页每道例题的步骤都标了它们。

  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Is it × or ÷? Factor every numerator and every denominator before anything else.是乘还是除？先把每个分子、每个分母都分解，再做别的。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    One fraction in lowest terms, followed by EVERY non-permissible value.一个最简分式，后面写上「全部」不允许值。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Draw three boxes for NPVs: bottom of fraction 1, bottom of fraction 2, and (for division only) top of the divisor. Fill all three before you flip.画三个格子装不允许值：第 1 个分式的分母、第 2 个分式的分母，以及（只在除法时）除式的分子。颠倒之前把三个格子都填好。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Division: keep the first fraction, change ÷ to ×, flip the SECOND fraction. Then cancel any top factor with any bottom factor and multiply what is left.除法：第一个分式不变，÷ 变 ×，把「第二个」分式颠倒。然后任一分子因式都可以和任一分母因式约分，再把剩下的乘起来。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Test an allowed value such as x=0 or x=1 in the original and in your answer. Count your NPVs against the three boxes.用一个允许的值（如 x=0 或 x=1）分别代入原式和答案。再对照三个格子数一数不允许值。

🧱 Prerequisite check先修检查

4 quick Grade 9–10 questions, about 3 minutes. Miss one and a 5-minute repair card opens right there; fix it, then carry on.4 道九、十年级小题，约 3 分钟。错了就在原地打开 5 分钟补救卡，补好再继续。

1Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算
Compute 32​÷94​.计算 32​÷94​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算 (Grade年级 7–9)
Add or subtract only with a common denominator: 21​+31​=63​+62​=65​. Multiply straight across. Divide = multiply by the reciprocal (flip the second fraction).加减必须先通分：21​+31​=63​+62​=65​。乘法分子乘分子、分母乘分母。除以一个分数＝乘它的倒数（把第二个分数倒过来）。
  1. 32​−41​: common denominator 12 → 128​−123​=125​.32​−41​：公分母 12 → 128​−123​=125​。
  2. 43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​.43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​。
  3. Never add denominators: 21​+31​=52​.分母不能相加：21​+31​=52​。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 65​−41​.化简 65​−41​。

2Factoring x2+bx+c (product and sum)分解 x2+bx+c（积与和）
Factor x2+2x−15.分解因式 x2+2x−15。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Factoring x2+bx+c (product and sum)分解 x2+bx+c（积与和） (Grade年级 10)
Take out a common factor first. Then find two numbers that MULTIPLY to c and ADD to b: x2−x−12 → −4 and 3 → (x−4)(x+3). Check by expanding.先提公因式。再找两个数，相乘等于 c、相加等于 b：x2−x−12 → −4 和 3 → (x−4)(x+3)。展开检验。
  1. x2+7x+10: 2×5=10, 2+5=7 → (x+2)(x+5).x2+7x+10：2×5=10，2+5=7 → (x+2)(x+5)。
  2. If c<0 the two numbers have different signs; if c>0 they share the sign of b.若 c<0，两个数异号；若 c>0，两个数与 b 同号。
Try one:试一道：
Factor x2−2x−15.分解 x2−2x−15。

3Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方）
Simplify x2x5​.化简 x2x5​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Exponent rules (product, quotient, power)指数运算法则（同底乘、除、乘方） (Grade年级 9)
Same base: multiply → ADD exponents (x3x4=x7); divide → SUBTRACT (x7÷x2=x5); power of a power → MULTIPLY ((x3)2=x6). A power of a product hits every factor: (2x)3=8x3.同底数：相乘→指数相加（x3x4=x7）；相除→指数相减（x7÷x2=x5）；幂的乘方→指数相乘（(x3)2=x6）。积的乘方每个因数都要乘方：(2x)3=8x3。
  1. (3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5.(3x2)2⋅x=9x4⋅x=9x5。
  2. 2x26x5​=3x3 (divide the numbers, subtract the exponents).2x26x5​=3x3（系数相除，指数相减）。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 4x(2x3)2​.化简 4x(2x3)2​。

Compute 43​⋅98​.计算 43​⋅98​。

Add or subtract only with a common denominator: 21​+31​=63​+62​=65​. Multiply straight across. Divide = multiply by the reciprocal (flip the second fraction).加减必须先通分：21​+31​=63​+62​=65​。乘法分子乘分子、分母乘分母。除以一个分数＝乘它的倒数（把第二个分数倒过来）。
  1. 32​−41​: common denominator 12 → 128​−123​=125​.32​−41​：公分母 12 → 128​−123​=125​。
  2. 43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​.43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​。
  3. Never add denominators: 21​+31​=52​.分母不能相加：21​+31​=52​。

🪜 Worked → fill in → your turn例题 → 填空 → 自己做

Three versions of one idea: read a full solution, then finish a half-done one, then do one yourself with hints you open one at a time.同一个思路的三个版本：先看完整解答，再补全半成品，最后自己做——提示一次只开一个。

① Worked example — read it完整例题——看懂
Simplify x2+2xx2−16​÷x+2x−4​ and state all NPVs.化简 x2+2xx2−16​÷x+2x−4​，并写出全部不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Division. Factor: x2−16=(x−4)(x+4), x2+2x=x(x+2).这是除法。分解：x2−16=(x−4)(x+4)，x2+2x=x(x+2)。
  2. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Box 1: x=0, −2. Box 2: x=−2. Box 3 (divisor top x−4): x=4. All: x=0, −2, 4.格子 1：x=0, −2。格子 2：x=−2。格子 3（除式分子 x−4）：x=4。合起来：x=0, −2, 4。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Flip the second: x(x+2)(x−4)(x+4)​⋅x−4x+2​.颠倒第二个：x(x+2)(x−4)(x+4)​⋅x−4x+2​。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Cancel (x−4) and (x+2): xx+4​.约去 (x−4) 和 (x+2)：xx+4​。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    At x=1: original 3−15​÷3−3​=−5÷(−1)=5; answer 15​=5 ✓.取 x=1：原式 3−15​÷3−3​=−5÷(−1)=5；答案 15​=5 ✓。
✔
xx+4​, x=0, −2, 4xx+4​，x=0, −2, 4
② Same idea — you fill the gaps同一思路——你来补空
Simplify x2−1x2−x−6​÷x+1x−3​ and state all NPVs.化简 x2−1x2−x−6​÷x+1x−3​，并写出全部不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Factor: x2−x−6=(x−3)(x+2), x2−1=(x−1)(x+1).分解：x2−x−6=(x−3)(x+2)，x2−1=(x−1)(x+1)。
  2. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    ✍️
    Your turn: fill the three NPV boxes.轮到你：填好三个不允许值格子。
    Box 1: x=±1. Box 2: x=−1. Box 3 (divisor top): x=3. All: x=±1, 3.格子 1：x=±1。格子 2：x=−1。格子 3（除式分子）：x=3。合起来：x=±1, 3。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    ✍️
    Your turn: flip the second fraction and cancel.轮到你：颠倒第二个分式并约分。
    (x−1)(x+1)(x−3)(x+2)​⋅x−3x+1​=x−1x+2​.(x−1)(x+1)(x−3)(x+2)​⋅x−3x+1​=x−1x+2​。
  4. ✅ Check检验
    At x=0: original −1−6​÷1−3​=6÷(−3)=−2; answer −12​=−2 ✓.取 x=0：原式 −1−6​÷1−3​=6÷(−3)=−2；答案 −12​=−2 ✓。
Answer答案
x−1x+2​, x=±1, 3x−1x+2​，x=±1, 3
③ Your turn — on paper first轮到你——先在纸上做
Simplify x2−5x2x2−8​÷x2−25x+2​ and state all NPVs.化简 x2−5x2x2−8​÷x2−25x+2​，并写出全部不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Factor all four parts. 2x2−8 has a common factor 2 first.四个部分都分解。2x2−8 要先提公因式 2。
  2. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Box 1 from x(x−5), box 2 from (x−5)(x+5), box 3 from the divisor top x+2.格子 1 来自 x(x−5)，格子 2 来自 (x−5)(x+5)，格子 3 来自除式分子 x+2。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Flip: x(x−5)2(x−2)(x+2)​⋅x+2(x−5)(x+5)​. Two pairs cancel.颠倒：x(x−5)2(x−2)(x+2)​⋅x+2(x−5)(x+5)​。有两对可以约。
  4. ✅ Check检验
    At x=1 the original equals −12. Does your answer?x=1 时原式等于 −12。你的答案也是吗？
x2(x−2)(x+5)​, x=0, ±5, −2x2(x−2)(x+5)​，x=0, ±5, −2
  1. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    NPVs: x=0, 5 (box 1), x=±5 (box 2), x=−2 (box 3). All: x=0, ±5, −2.不允许值：x=0, 5（格子 1），x=±5（格子 2），x=−2（格子 3）。合起来：x=0, ±5, −2。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Cancel (x+2) and (x−5): x2(x−2)(x+5)​.约去 (x+2) 和 (x−5)：x2(x−2)(x+5)​。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    At x=1: original −4−6​÷−243​=23​⋅(−8)=−12; answer 12(−1)(6)​=−12 ✓.取 x=1：原式 −4−6​÷−243​=23​⋅(−8)=−12；答案 12(−1)(6)​=−12 ✓。

Example 1例 1L1 Know知道
Simplify 5c6a2b​÷15c24ab3​. State the restrictions.化简 5c6a2b​÷15c24ab3​，写出限制条件。
  1. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Restrictions: c=0 (bottoms) and a=0, b=0 (top of the divisor).限制条件：c=0（分母），a=0，b=0（除式的分子）。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    5c6a2b​⋅4ab315c2​. Numbers: 5⋅46⋅15​=2090​=29​.5c6a2b​⋅4ab315c2​。数字：5⋅46⋅15​=2090​=29​。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Variables: aa2​=a, b3b​=b21​, cc2​=c. Result 2b29ac​.字母：aa2​=a，b3b​=b21​，cc2​=c。结果 2b29ac​。
Answer答案
2b29ac​, a,b,c=0

💡 Key idea解题思路
Flip the second fraction and multiply; the restrictions come from every denominator before the flip, including the divisor.把第二个分式倒过来相乘；限制条件要看翻转之前的所有分母，包括除式本身。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Flip and cancel numbers and powers.翻转后约去数字和幂。
  • Simplify each fraction first, then divide.先分别化简每个分式，再做除法。
Example 2例 2L2 Apply会做2 methods种解法
Simplify x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​，写出不允许值。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    x(x−4)(x−3)(x+3)​⋅x+32x​. NPVs: x=0,4,−3.x(x−4)(x−3)(x+3)​⋅x+32x​。不允许值：x=0,4,−3。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Cancel (x+3) and x: x−42(x−3)​.约去 (x+3) 和 x：x−42(x−3)​。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    (x2−4x)(x+3)2x(x2−9)​=x3−x2−12x2x3−18x​.(x2−4x)(x+3)2x(x2−9)​=x3−x2−12x2x3−18x​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Now you must factor degree-3 polynomials: x(x−4)(x+3)2x(x−3)(x+3)​=x−42(x−3)​. Same answer, more work — factor first.这下得分解三次式：x(x−4)(x+3)2x(x−3)(x+3)​=x−42(x−3)​。答案相同但更费事——先分解更好。
Answer答案
x−42(x−3)​, x=0,4,−3
🧭 What this example trains这道题练什么
🎯 Goal考查目标
Multiply two rational expressions by factoring and cancelling across them.分解后在两个分式之间约分，完成乘法。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简Difference of squares & perfect squares平方差与完全平方Greatest common factor & grouping提公因式与分组分解
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
💡 Key idea解题思路
Factor every numerator and denominator, cancel across the multiplication sign, then list NPVs from the original denominators.先把所有分子分母分解，跨乘号约分，再由原分母列出不允许值。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Factor, cancel, then multiply what is left.先分解、约分，再乘剩下的部分。
  • Multiply the fractions first, then factor and cancel (works but the numbers are bigger).先乘成一个分式，再分解约分（可行，但式子更大）。
Example 3例 3L3 Connect会用
Simplify x2−4x2−x−6​÷x2+x−2x2−9​ and state all non-permissible values.化简 x2−4x2−x−6​÷x2+x−2x2−9​，写出全部不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Factor: x2−x−6=(x−3)(x+2); x2−4=(x−2)(x+2); x2−9=(x−3)(x+3); x2+x−2=(x+2)(x−1).分解：x2−x−6=(x−3)(x+2)；x2−4=(x−2)(x+2)；x2−9=(x−3)(x+3)；x2+x−2=(x+2)(x−1)。
  2. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    NPVs from the two bottoms: x=2,−2,1. From the divisor’s top (it will be flipped down): x=3,−3. All together: x=±2, ±3, 1.两个分母给出：x=2,−2,1。除式的分子（颠倒后到分母）给出：x=3,−3。合起来：x=±2, ±3, 1。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Flip and multiply: (x−2)(x+2)(x−3)(x+2)​⋅(x−3)(x+3)(x+2)(x−1)​.颠倒相乘：(x−2)(x+2)(x−3)(x+2)​⋅(x−3)(x+3)(x+2)(x−1)​。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Cancel (x−3) once and (x+2) once: (x−2)(x+3)(x+2)(x−1)​.约去一个 (x−3) 和一个 (x+2)：(x−2)(x+3)(x+2)(x−1)​。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Check at x=0: original −4−6​÷−2−9​=23​⋅92​=31​; answer (−2)(3)(2)(−1)​=31​ ✓.用 x=0 验算：原式 −4−6​÷−2−9​=23​⋅92​=31​；答案 (−2)(3)(2)(−1)​=31​ ✓。
Answer答案
(x−2)(x+3)(x+2)(x−1)​, x=±2,±3,1
🧭 What this example trains这道题练什么
🎯 Goal考查目标
Divide rational expressions with quadratics and collect all NPVs, including from the divisor numerator.做含二次式的有理式除法，并收集全部不允许值，包括除式分子产生的。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简Factoring trinomials ax²+bx+c三项式 ax²+bx+c 的分解Difference of squares & perfect squares平方差与完全平方
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
💡 Key idea解题思路
Factor all four parts, flip, cancel; then NPVs include zeros of the divisor numerator, because it becomes a denominator.四部分都分解，翻转，约分；不允许值还要包括除式分子的零点，因为它翻转后成了分母。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Factor everything, flip, cancel.全部分解、翻转、约分。
  • Check with a test value such as x=4 in the original and the answer.取一个值如 x=4，分别代入原式和结果检验。

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Someone made each of these. Tap the line where it first goes wrong.每道题都有人这样做过。点出第一处出错的那一行。

1Missing the NPV from the divisor's numerator漏了除式分子给出的不允许值
Simplify x+2x−5​÷x−1x−5​ and state all NPVs.化简 x+2x−5​÷x−1x−5​，并写出全部不允许值。

🧠 After flipping, the divisor's top x−5 lands on the bottom. At x=5 you would be dividing by 40​=0, which is not allowed.颠倒以后，除式的分子 x−5 跑到了分母。x=5 时等于除以 40​=0，不允许。

🔧 Three boxes: x=−2, x=1, and x=5 from the divisor top. Answer x+2x−1​, x=−2, 1, 5.三个格子：x=−2，x=1，以及除式分子给出的 x=5。答案 x+2x−1​，x=−2, 1, 5。

✔ x+2x−1​, x=−2, 1, 5x+2x−1​，x=−2, 1, 5

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 A, Check-up测评 Q2 B

2Cancelling across a plus sign隔着加号约分
Simplify xx+5​⋅x2−252x​.化简 xx+5​⋅x2−252x​。

🧠 In x+5 the x is a term that is ADDED, not a factor of the whole top. At x=1, xx+5​=6, not 5.x+5 里的 x 是相加的项，不是整个分子的因式。x=1 时 xx+5​=6，不是 5。

🔧 Factor: xx+5​⋅(x−5)(x+5)2x​; cancel x (top of one, bottom of the other) and (x+5): x−52​, x=0, ±5.先分解：xx+5​⋅(x−5)(x+5)2x​；约去 x（一个在分子、一个在另一分式的分母）和 (x+5)：x−52​，x=0, ±5。

✔ x−52​, x=0, ±5x−52​，x=0, ±5

3Losing the divisor's old denominator after flipping颠倒后丢了除式原来的分母
Simplify x−32x​÷x+4x+1​ and state all NPVs.化简 x−32x​÷x+4x+1​，并写出全部不允许值。

🧠 Reading the NPVs from the final bottom misses x+4: it was a denominator in the ORIGINAL question and moved to the top when it was flipped. At x=−4 the original has 0−3​.只看最后的分母会漏掉 x+4：它在「原题」里是分母，颠倒后才跑到分子上。x=−4 时原式出现 0−3​。

🔧 List NPVs before flipping: x=3, x=−4, and x=−1 from the divisor top.颠倒之前列不允许值：x=3，x=−4，以及除式分子给出的 x=−1。

✔ (x−3)(x+1)2x(x+4)​, x=3, −4, −1(x−3)(x+1)2x(x+4)​，x=3, −4, −1

4Cancelling a power completely把幂整个约光了
Simplify 4xx2−9​⋅x+38x3​.化简 4xx2−9​⋅x+38x3​。

🧠 xx3​=x2: one x cancels and two are left. Writing x subtracts 2 from the exponent instead of 1.xx3​=x2：约掉一个 x，还剩两个。写成 x 等于指数减了 2 而不是 1。

🔧 4x8x3​=2x2, so the answer is 2x2(x−3), x=0, −3.4x8x3​=2x2，所以答案是 2x2(x−3)，x=0, −3。

✔ 2x2(x−3), x=0, −32x2(x−3)，x=0, −3

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 A

5Flipping the wrong fraction颠倒错了分式
Simplify x+3x​÷x2−9x2​ and state all NPVs.化简 x+3x​÷x2−9x2​，并写出全部不允许值。

🧠 Dividing by a fraction means multiplying by the reciprocal of the DIVISOR, the second fraction. Flipping the first one computes its upside-down value instead.除以一个分式等于乘以「除式」——也就是第二个分式——的倒数。颠倒第一个分式算的是完全不同的东西。

🔧 x+3x​⋅x2(x−3)(x+3)​=xx−3​. NPVs: x=−3, x=±3, and x=0 from the divisor top x2.x+3x​⋅x2(x−3)(x+3)​=xx−3​。不允许值：x=−3，x=±3，以及除式分子 x2 给出的 x=0。

✔ xx−3​, x=0, ±3xx−3​，x=0, ±3

⚠️ Quick list速查

  • Flipping the wrong fraction, or flipping before writing NPVs. Write NPVs first, then flip only the SECOND fraction.颠倒错了分式，或者颠倒后才写不允许值。先写不允许值，再只颠倒第二个分式。
  • Missing the NPVs from the divisor’s numerator — in ÷x+1x−5​, x=5 too.漏掉除式分子带来的不允许值——÷x+1x−5​ 中还要 x=5。
  • Cancelling across a plus sign: in xx+3​, nothing cancels.跨加号约分：xx+3​ 中什么都不能约。

Rational Expressions Multiplying and Dividing
Mario's Math Tutoring · 6 min · ↗
The two-fraction layout (factor all four pieces, cancel diagonally) is exactly the method in our examples, and the "multiplied versus subtracted" explanation is the clearest reason not to cancel terms. The video never talks about non-permissible values, so you must find those yourself from the original denominators.先分解四个部分、再斜着约，正是我们例题的做法；「是乘还是减」的解释也把「为什么不能约项」讲得最清楚。视频里完全没提不允许的值，要自己从原来的分母去找。
⏩ From 0:00 to about 3:45 (the last example, from 3:42, uses cubes; skip it unless your teacher teaches them): factor every numerator and denominator first, then cancel a factor on top against the same factor on the bottom, even across the two fractions. Example 1 (0:22) ends as (x−5)(x−3)x(x−4)​, left in factored form. 1:33 division is "keep, change, flip". 2:59 he explains why you cannot cancel the x in 3x against the x in x−4: one is multiplied, the other is subtracted.从 0:00 看到约 3:45（最后一个例子从 3:42 开始，用了立方，老师没教就跳过）：先把每个分子分母都分解，再把上面的因式和下面相同的因式约掉，两个分数之间也可以交叉约。例 1（0:22）结果是 (x−5)(x−3)x(x−4)​，保持因式形式就行。1:33 除法就是「不动、变乘、翻转」。2:59 他解释了为什么不能把 3x 里的 x 和 x−4 里的 x 约掉：一个是乘，一个是减。
Multiplying and Dividing Rational Expression, GUIDED EXAMPLES - Pre-Calculus 11, Algebra II
Mathsupport · 10 min · ↗
It is the only video here that does multiplying, the non-permissible values, and dividing in one sitting. It does not say that when you divide, the numerator of the fraction you flip must not be zero either, so add those values yourself.这是这里唯一把乘法、不允许的值和除法放在一起讲的视频。它没有说「除法里被翻转的那个分数，它的分子也不能为零」，这一点要自己补上。
⏩ From 3:07 (about 6.5 minutes; the first 3 minutes review multiplying plain fractions): multiply two rational expressions by factoring x2+7x+10=(x+5)(x+2) and x2+x−6=(x+3)(x−2), cancelling x+5 and x+3, and getting x−2x+2​. 5:11 the non-permissible values come from the ORIGINAL factored denominators: x=−3, 2, −5. 7:03 division "keep, change, flip" with 9m2−4n2 and 3m2n−3mn2, ending as (m−n)(3m+2n)3mn​.从 3:07 开始（约 6.5 分钟；前 3 分钟是普通分数乘法的复习）：做两个有理式相乘，先分解 x2+7x+10=(x+5)(x+2) 和 x2+x−6=(x+3)(x−2)，约去 x+5 和 x+3，得 x−2x+2​。5:11 不允许的值要看「原来分母」分解后的因式：x=−3, 2, −5。7:03 除法「不动、变乘、翻转」，例子里有 9m2−4n2 和 3m2n−3mn2，结果是 (m−n)(3m+2n)3mn​。

📝 Test-style problems考题实战

Multiplying Rational Expressions
The Organic Chemistry Tutor · 10 min · ↗
The excluded values at 6:31 are the point most students miss: a factor that cancels still stays forbidden, because the expression before simplifying is not defined there. Multiplication only; he does not cover division, so use the next video for that.6:31 的不允许的值是最多同学漏掉的地方：被约掉的因式所对应的值仍然不能取，因为化简前的式子在那里没有定义。这个视频只讲乘法，没讲除法，除法看下一个视频。
⏩ From 0:00 to about 7:15 (the last problem, from 7:15, has cubes; skip it unless your teacher teaches them). 0:05 2x2−87x+14​⋅(x2+3x−10) becomes 27(x+5)​ (factor all, cancel x+2 and x−2). 2:13 a longer one with a 5x2−15x and a 10x3−70x2+120x ends as 2(2x+3)3​. 6:31 then the key part: even though x−4, x−3, x and x+4 cancelled, the excluded values still come from the ORIGINAL denominators: x=−4, 4, 0, 3, −23​.从 0:00 看到约 7:15（最后一题从 7:15 开始，用了立方，老师没教就跳过）。0:05 2x2−87x+14​⋅(x2+3x−10) 化成 27(x+5)​（全部分解，约去 x+2 和 x−2）。2:13 一道更长的题（有 5x2−15x 和 10x3−70x2+120x）最后得 2(2x+3)3​。6:31 是重点：虽然 x−4、x−3、x、x+4 都约掉了，不允许的值仍然要从「原来的分母」找：x=−4, 4, 0, 3, −23​。

1. Simplify x+3x2−4​⋅x−2x+3​ (type x+2).化简 x+3x2−4​⋅x−2x+3​（输入 x+2）。
x2−4=(x−2)(x+2): the (x−2) cancels, (x+2) stays.x2−4=(x−2)(x+2)：约去 (x−2)，留下 (x+2)。
Keep cancelling: the answer has no fraction left.继续约分：答案里不再有分式。

✔ x+2

Factor x2−4=(x−2)(x+2), cancel (x+3) and (x−2): x+2.分解 x2−4=(x−2)(x+2)，约去 (x+3) 和 (x−2)：得 x+2。

2. Simplify x−1x+1​÷x+4x+1​ (type a fraction like (x+4)/(x-1)).化简 x−1x+1​÷x+4x+1​（输入分式如 (x+4)/(x-1)）。
You flipped the wrong fraction. Keep the first, flip the second.倒错了分式。第一个不动，倒第二个。

✔ x−1x+4​

Flip the second fraction and multiply: x−1x+1​⋅x+1x+4​=x−1x+4​.把第二个分式倒过来再乘：x−1x+1​⋅x+1x+4​=x−1x+4​。

3. For the division in the last question, give ALL non-permissible values.对上一题的除法，写出所有不允许值。
x ≠ , ,
Also check the numerator of the fraction you divide by: x+1=0.还要检查除数的分子：x+1=0。

✔ x ≠ -4 , -1 , 1 −4,−1,1

Denominators: x=1 and x=−4. The divisor's numerator x+1=0 gives x=−1 too.分母：x=1 和 x=−4。除数的分子 x+1=0 也给出 x=−1。

4. Simplify x2−92x​⋅4xx+3​.化简 x2−92x​⋅4xx+3​。
1 / ( ( x − ) )
2x/4x=1/2: the leftover number is 2.2x/4x=1/2：剩下的数是 2。

✔ 1 / ( 2 ( x − 3 ) ) 2(x−3)1​

(x−3)(x+3)⋅4x2x(x+3)​=2(x−3)1​.(x−3)(x+3)⋅4x2x(x+3)​=2(x−3)1​。

5. Simplify 5y6x2​÷10y23x​ (type 4xy).化简 5y6x2​÷10y23x​（输入 4xy）。
Do the numbers too: 60/15=4.数字也要算：60/15=4。
Keep cancelling: the answer has no fraction left.继续约分：答案里不再有分式。

✔ 4∗x∗y

5y6x2​⋅3x10y2​=15xy60x2y2​=4xy.5y6x2​⋅3x10y2​=15xy60x2y2​=4xy。

🗣️ Explain it back用自己的话讲一遍

When you divide rational expressions, which expressions give you non-permissible values?做有理式除法时，哪些式子会产生不允许值？

Every denominator, and also the numerator of the fraction you divide BY, because dividing by it means multiplying by its flip, which would then have a zero denominator.所有分母，还有「被除数后面的那个分式」的分子：除以它等于乘它的倒数，倒过来后它的分子就成了分母，不能为零。

Three sources: two bottoms and the divisor’s top.三处来源：两个分母和除式的分子。
(x−5)(x+2)x(x−1)​, x=5,1,−2(x−5)(x+2)x(x−1)​，x=5,1,−2

(x−3)(x−1)

8L4 Solve会想🌍 Modelling建模🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练
A ferry route is modelled with a design parameter x>4. The crossing distance is D=xx2−16​ km and the ferry speed is v=x2x2−x−12​ km/min. (a) Write the crossing time t=D÷v as one simplified expression and list every non-permissible value. (b) Explain why only x>4 makes sense for the story. (c) For x=8, find D, v and t, and convert v to km/h.一条渡轮航线用设计参数 x>4 建模。航程为 D=xx2−16​ km，渡轮速度为 v=x2x2−x−12​ km/min。(a) 把航行时间 t=D÷v 写成一个最简式，并列出所有不允许值。(b) 说明为什么只有 x>4 才符合情境。(c) 当 x=8 时求 D、v、t，并把 v 换算成 km/h。
Dividing by v means multiplying by x2−x−12x2​. Factor first.除以 v 就是乘以 x2−x−12x2​。先分解因式。
(a) t=x+3x(x+4)​ min, x=0,4,−3; (b) x−4>0 makes both D and v positive; (c) D=6 km, v=1611​ km/min =41.25 km/h, t=1196​≈8.7 min.(a) t=x+3x(x+4)​ 分钟，x=0,4,−3；(b) x−4>0 才使 D 和 v 同为正；(c) D=6 km，v=1611​ km/min =41.25 km/h，t=1196​≈8.7 分钟。
  1. t=x(x−4)(x+4)​⋅(x−4)(x+3)x2​=x+3x(x+4)​.t=x(x−4)(x+4)​⋅(x−4)(x+3)x2​=x+3x(x+4)​。
  2. NPVs: x=0 (from D and v), x=4 and x=−3 (zeros of the divisor numerator x2−x−12).不允许值：x=0（来自 D 和 v 的分母），x=4 和 x=−3（除式分子 x2−x−12 的零点）。
  3. Distance and speed are positive only if x−4>0 (the other factors x+4, x+3, x are then positive), so x>4.距离和速度为正，必须 x−4>0（此时其余因式 x+4、x+3、x 都为正），所以 x>4。
  4. x=8: D=848​=6 km; v=6464−8−12​=6444​=1611​ km/min =1611​⋅60=41.25 km/h; t=11/166​=1196​≈8.7 min, matching 118⋅12​=1196​.x=8：D=848​=6 km；v=6464−8−12​=6444​=1611​ km/min =1611​⋅60=41.25 km/h；t=11/166​=1196​≈8.7 分钟，与 118⋅12​=1196​ 一致。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Divide two rational models, collect every restriction, and match them to the sensible domain in context.对两个有理式模型做除法，收集全部限制，并与情境下合理的范围对应。
